This evidence is stronger and more PRS-informative than the ExPRSweb sleep apnea framework models (PGS003204–PGS003218), which have full-model AUROCs near 0.49–0.53 and weak/near-null ORs. Limitation: the key discrimination metric available for PGS005220 is full-model AUROC (no explicit PGS-only AUC/R2), and covariates include BMI, so the reported AUROC may be partially covariate-driven; also a closely competing sibling (PGS005219, AdjustedBMI) has the same AUROC and an even stronger OR (1.98), making the choice not unequivocal purely from the provided metadata.

All 20 returned candidates are direct matches for urinary bladder cancer/bladder cancer (mostly EFO: urinary bladder carcinoma), so a direct-match exists. Among the candidates with PRS-relevant signal, PGS000611 (GWAS Hits; 13 variants) has supportive effect-size evidence (OR per SD 1.284, 95% CI 1.211–1.361) and a strong extreme-tail contrast (OR top 1% vs rest 2.66, 95% CI 1.79–3.93) with basic covariates (age, sex, batch, PCs 1–4), and it is evaluated in Europeans. Competing disease-focused models like PGS000071/PGS000782 report very high full-model AUROC (~0.80) but include multiple non-genetic risk factors (e.g., smoking variables, BMI) and do not report PRS-only discrimination, so their AUROC is likely covariate-driven and not directly comparable for PRS ranking. Other Cancer PRSweb siblings (e.g., PGS000610/612/613) are close, but PGS000611 offers the clearest combination of comparable covariate-light evaluation plus strong, explicitly reported genetic effect-size metrics. Limitation: no candidate in the context reports a clearly PRS-only AUROC/R², and several near-clone alternatives exist with similar endpoint fidelity and metrics, so the choice is not unequivocally best-supported.

All 20 candidates are direct matches (bladder cancer / urinary bladder carcinoma). Selection remains sub-optimal because no candidate provides an explicit PRS-only AUROC/R², and multiple near-clone alternatives have very similar endpoint fidelity and effect sizes (e.g., PGS000610/PGS000612/PGS000613), limiting a clearly definitive best choice from the visible metadata alone.
